Text: Subhan Allah Wa Alhamdu Lillah Wa La Elaha Ella Allah
Speaker: Dr. Rashad Khalifa
Description: Dr. Rashad Khalifa devotes the first sermon to numerical findings contributed by three people. He reviews what he calls the miracle of miracles, in which the units of the five daily prayers written alongside representations of Sura 1, including its verse count, letter counts and numerical values, produce multiples of 19 even when the order is reversed; presents Saeed Talari's tally of the Fatehahs, bowings, prostrations and tashahuds in each prayer; and adds Edip Yuksel's observation that the lips meet exactly nineteen times when Al-Fatehah is recited, together with Soad's finding that the letter-position values of Noah, Abraham and Muhammad match the verse counts of the chapters bearing their names. In the second sermon he speaks about his mother's death, which he learned of days after preaching that the righteous do not die but go straight to Heaven, and reads the sequence of events as an assurance of the kind promised in Sura 41:30. He describes a mocking telephone call that preceded the news, the circumstances of her death while waiting for a cup of tea, the funeral prayer in Egypt led unexpectedly by a believer who opened the Quran to the example of Pharaoh's wife, and contrasts his grief at his father's death, which he believes came in disbelief, with his present happiness. Related recording: the Sura 1 and prayer-unit finding reviewed at the start was first presented in "48 - Friday Sermon The Heavenly Feud, The Importance of Killing the Ego (11-29-1989)" in this collection.
